reading_from_stopping_condition_text.observation: The predicate 'release/canary succeeds' names a canary (and/or a release) as the event that must succeed. A canary channel is a referent the predicate requires.

waiver_discipline.rule: An unsatisfiable-as-written stopping condition may only be closed by an owner-recorded waiver or an owner-recorded equivalent formulation. Reinterpreting the predicate (for example reading 'canary' as 'PR') is forbidden. Marking NOT-APPLICABLE without a recorded owner justification is forbidden. Inheriting PHASE-GRAPH.json is not a close.
